title: froelichia nudicaulis subsp. lanigera
intro: Froelichia nudicaulis subsp. lanigera, commonly known as the "woolly desert holly," is a plant species belonging to the Amaranthaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Froelichia nudicaulis subsp. lanigera include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
